svg.title: World religious composition, 2020-3030 (exploratory beyond 2100)
svg.text: Share of world population. Reference scenario (stabilising): mean and 5-95% of 40 runs. Grey: the range of all 8 scenario means. Each panel has its own scale.
Time axis in two parts: 2020-2100 (WPP-based demography) takes 40% of the width, 2100-3030 (stated long-run assumptions) the remaining 60%; the vertical line marks 2100.
Beyond 2100 the lines show what the stated assumptions imply, not forecasts; the run spread is parameter uncertainty only and there are no predictive intervals.
